name: Inkling 2 Mini
description: Experimental Inkling looped multimodal MoE through an isolated, pinned vLLM runtime; concurrency one and 8K serving context on GB10.
limitations: Requires the pinned ARM64 Inkling vLLM image. SparkLab's native engine does not implement this architecture.
The checkpoint mixes NVFP4 and MXFP8 experts; nvfp4 names the checkpoint's ModelOpt quantization family.
The 8K context is a conservative local profile, not the checkpoint's advertised 1M maximum. Long-context and endurance qualification remain outstanding.
DSpark speculative decoding is disabled. The bundled mtp.safetensors is downloaded but unused by this profile.
Short smoke checks do not establish general reasoning, coding, vision, or tool-use quality.
